basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and Dark Souls enthusiast hailing from Houston, Texas. When I'm not trading boss souls or mulling over game strategies, you can find me exploring the latest tech gadgets or attending comic conventions. I work as a software developer, which keeps me busy during the weekdays. In a committed relationship with my fellow gamer girlfriend. Typically online during late evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught gamer with a passion for RPGs, especially the Souls series. Learned through countless hours of gameplay and community interactions. Professionally, I have a degree in Computer Science, which aids in my understanding of game mechanics and software development.
